gas: A half-destroyed roof sways in the wind, and from under the broken neon comes the smell of kerosene and damp bushes.
A burnt car lies on the asphalt, and in the shadow between pumps, something heavy breathes, waiting for prey.
The wind hums in the cracks of concrete pillars, and invisible cold pours from the darkness, making the hair on your body stand up.
mart: Inside smells of damp flour and corpse rot, while empty eyes of shelves stare from behind broken display cases.
Quiet, except for creaking floors far away. The cold Fog sends shivers down your skin.
Dirty bottles lie in the undergrowth, and something rustles in the corner—probably a new mutant hunting for food.
wood: Thick gray Fog spreads over the ground, letting almost no light through, while uneasy rustling comes from under the crown of a dead pine.
The air smells of damp earth and rot, and in the distance someone grinds bitterly and hoarsely, like stone on stone.
No birds, no insects—only faint movement in the shadows. These woods want you as food.
laundry: The door slammed shut behind, revealing rows of rusty washing machines standing silently in the half-dark.
A stale smell of old soap and damp brick rises from the floor, while a broken neon sign nervously flickers above empty tables.
Silence here is thick and sticky, as if waiting for the first shadows to emerge from under every car.
bus: Darkness reigns inside the broken bus, and dry grass crunches underfoot, having grown through holes in the floor.
Fresh rot and dampness smell like a swamp, and a creepy snorting of something huge drifts in from behind broken windows.
Silent as a tomb. Gloomy Fog slides over the torn roof, hiding something under the seats.
houses: Sulfurous Fog spreads over cracks in old planks, and the undergrowth smells of rotten earth and oxidation.
Silence here is oppressive; only the swing sways in the wind, as if someone just jumped off.
Soft rustling of something alive, not human, is heard from under the fence maze.
school: The corridor groaned with wind playing with glass shards, smelling of mold and ash.
Dim lamps flicker. Something rustles in the corners—mutants are already here.
Faded murals remain on the walls, and broken desks crunch underfoot, along with a history burned with the city.
res: The old dam cracks underfoot, and occasionally rotting steam bursts from the ground, smelling of vinegar and copper.
Shadows hide in the dark pipes, and every drop falling from the ceiling sounds like a gunshot.
Deadly quiet—even mutants fear this place where water mixes with black magic.
depot: Inside smells of old rust and dampness, while broken carriages sway in the dark like shadows of dead beasts.
No fire in sight, only the quiet clicking of broken wires and the distant, raspy grinding of mutants.
The Fog here is especially thick and sticky, so every shadow can quickly become lava for a hungry, toothy monster.
market: Old wooden tents with torn tarps sway in the wind, and the thin air smells of rotten tobacco oil and old iron.
Glass crunches underfoot, and from dark corners comes the faint clicking of small mutants scavenging among the trash.
The air smells of rotting meat and slag, while hanging lanterns flicker as if warning of an invisible threat in the Fog.
fire: Inside smells of old wood and fire, and a half-burnt red car stands frozen in the moment of the blaze.
Listen carefully—somewhere deep in the darkness, water splashes, and someone might suddenly peek out from behind the rack.
Quiet, yet uneasy. Shadows lurk in the corners, ready to turn into mutants any moment.
library: Dust falls softly, sunlight cuts through the darkness via a hole in the ceiling.
The air is thick with the smell of old paper and decay, while shadows hide on the shelves.
It's completely deserted, but listen for the crunch of bones underfoot.
hosp: Fluorescent lamps flicker, casting shadows on the walls that seem alive and ominous.
Air smells of rot and old meds; something lifeless hides in dark corners.
It's too quiet to be safe, but that breathing sound is too loud to be human.
tower: Inside it's cold and smells of old metal, while thick Fog outside hums dully, as if trying to break through the walls.
Glass crunches underfoot, and in the darkness hide shadows whispering the names of those you lost in your past life.
Broken antennas flicker around, and any sudden move might trigger an attack by sound-hunting mutants.
rift: Thick gray Fog instantly embraces the shoulders, and the air fills with the smell of ozonated metal and burnt meat.
The air trembles with a faint purple glow from the Rift, and strange stone fragments float weightlessly around.
Your ear itches from a low, almost inaudible hum, as if space itself groans in pain, and shadows that haven't become mutants sway in the fog.
metro: Water up to the knees, lamps flickering in the dark, trying not to go out.
You hear the quiet dripping of water and the heavy breathing of mutants hiding in the tunnels.
It smells of mold, old rust, and something sharp, magical, tickling your nose.
army: A heavy scent of old earth and gunpowder rises from under rusted tank hulls, and in the distance, the hum of mutants is heard.
Barbed wire creaks in the wind, and sandbags around the watchtower look freshly abandoned.
Empty, dead, and cold, but you know: somewhere in the ruins hide those who won't share resources with you.
bgarden: Air thick with a sweet, poisonous scent. A shattered glass dome above crackles, letting rain of light through.
Giant flowers pulse with dim light; predators lurk in their shadows, waiting for your prey.
You hear only heavy breathing of plants and snapping branches, for anyone here could become a weapon against you.
pharmacy: A glass equipment rack is shattered, and empty medicine wrappers scattered on the floor crunch underfoot.
The air smells of old medicine and dust; a faint rustling from a mutant echoes behind the broken display case.
The green cross on the sign still glows, but inside there's darkness and deadly silence—not to be disturbed.
kiosk: Gray kiosk ruins smell of rotten water and old dust, while shattered glass crunches underfoot on the asphalt.
You hear only the wind whistling through broken signs, while something unknown but dangerous hides in the Fog.
Kiosk walls are covered with faded posters recalling the world before the catastrophe, while the road around is completely empty and dead.
garage: The sulfurous smell of fuel and rotting grass hits your nose as you step between two rusty garage bays.
Restless shadows stretch from under metal doors, and far away, a grinding sound echoes, as if someone is searching for keys in an old engine.
The spotlight flickers, illuminating a pile of tires swaying like living things, and you realize: you could get lost here forever.
bakery: Inside, thick white dust covers huge, cold furnaces; only a faint, dying screech comes from the conveyors.
The air is thick with flour dust choking your throat, while shadows that could be mutants hide in the dim corridors.
Stale flour mold and old metal smell. Fresh tracks on the conveyor belts show survivors were here recently.
parking: A sharp smell of disinfectant and rotting mold spreads over the cold concrete.
Blinding flashlight beams cut through the darkness where rusted cars hide behind a pair of mutants.
Water drips motionless from the roof, creating a rhythmic drip, as if someone lurks in the half-dark.
church: The bell tower is ruined, but old candles still burn on the altar, and the air is thick with the smell of fire, dampness, and smoldering mold.
Cold Fog seeps through cracks in the crypt, and from dark corners comes the quiet grinding of bones hiding among graves.
Broken tiles crunch underfoot, and the gloomy silence is broken only by the rhythmic whisper of invisible creatures waiting for a mistake.
power: Oversized cooling towers are silent, but inside, the air smells of rotting water and oxidant.
Dim light breaks through torn pipes, and from below comes the rare rustle of mutants.
Each step on rusty pipes echoes like an explosion in this dead silence, where the Fog won't let you look back.
port: Silent old cranes tower over the murky river, while abandoned barges reek of decay and rusty water.
Thick Fog wraps the pier like a handkerchief, where only the creak of metal and the whisper of hidden mutants can be heard.
The air is heavy with moisture and the smell of old ropes, while an inevitable threat hides among the ruins.
mall: Ice cracks in the roof under the wind, while dust and rot from broken flowers float in the air.
The elevator and escalators froze in twisted positions, and something rustles in the dark corners, like a mutant hunting for food.
You hear only the echo of your own steps, but from the rubble, a dark slime begins to crawl slowly.
prison: Barbed wire barely holding a lie wraps around towers, while cold Fog spreads like a creeping cloud over broken brick walls.
Only the wind's whisper among empty cells and a sharp rot smell from under the grates.
Grey prison outlines cling to the horizon like a dead beast's skeleton; here you'll meet only mutants or shadows of the past.
lab: Seems someone just entered. Air is thick with faint purple Fog and ozone.
Glass vials are broken, their LED light fading in the darkness of the dungeon.
A survivor was just here, but you hear no footsteps—only the deep, dragging breath of the magical Rift.
airport: The terminal entrance greets you with the smell of rotting fuel and damp rust, while thick gray Fog pours through the broken roof.
A shattered liner lies on the runway, as if swallowed by a black shadow, while a torn passenger bridge clings to its wings.
Silent for a moment. Mutants hide in the Fog, ready to emerge from any debris at any second.
bridge: Before you lies a broken bridge, twisted steel hanging over a black river, with shattered cars barely clinging to the edge.
Through the thick Fog, only the creak of metal and distant creaking are heard, and the air smells of ozone and decay.
Don't panic here, as mutants hiding in the Fog hunt any movement.
stadium: You smell of rotting earth and sweetish mold, while fog slowly circles above the ruined bleachers.
Low humming comes from dark niches, as if giant mutant insects hide in fungal roots.
It's easy to get lost among broken concrete blocks, as every shadow can become a trap for your life.
dam: Open doors are flooded with the roar of water pushing against cracked concrete walls, and immediately your nose tastes rust and free dampness.
The Black Control Tower creaks in the wind, and the unknown stares from its dark windows, as if the Dam itself awaits a victim.
Water bursts out like an enraged beast; every step on the slippery surface could be your last in this cursed place.
crater: A massive depression glows purple, the air thick with the smell of burnt glass.
Thick fog spreads from under black ash, where a quiet crackling, like breathing, comes from crystals.
Building debris lies at the crater's edge, and something from the depths stares out, making your heart beat faster.
tvcenter: Inside the TV center smells of burnt plastic and old dust, and a huge antenna creaks in the wind everywhere.
The creak of old cables underfoot and the quiet hiss of shattered screens flickering with white noise heighten the tension.
It's too dark to spot shadows that might be mutants, and the Fog Rift hums faintly behind the walls.
core: A purple vortex spins over the abyss, swallowing even light, with old building fragments hanging from it like giant bones.
The air is thick with the smell of ozonated metal and old blood, and an invisible pressure on your face breaks your mind.
No sound, just a loud buzzing in your head warning: one step into this shadow could be your last.

rat: This mutant looks like a torn sack of bones, covered in slimy dirty fur and red eyes glowing in the dark.
He hisses and bares his teeth, trying to leap at the hero as soon as he spots him in the Fog.
dog: A feral dog looks like a torn sack of fur, covered in crusts and rotten foam on its teeth.
He howls in rage, creaking with rotten teeth, and charges at the hero like a mad dog.
slime: His body is a hideous mass of rusty slime, with sharp metal shards embedded inside.
He instantly crawls out of the shadows, grumbling with metal, and tries to wrap around the hero to turn him into new rusty armor.
centi: A giant centipede with a crimson shell oozing poisonous slime, like a living toxic cylinder.
She coils like a spring and attacks, not waiting for the enemy to gather strength.
ratqueen: A giant rat with a skull crown surrounded by a cloud of evil rodents.
She freezes instantly, assessing your threat before swarming you.
goblin: A tiny green-skinned creature with sharp ears, a wide wicked smile, and a bag on its shoulder gleaming with stolen loot.
He freezes in place to avoid detection, with a treacherous glint in his eyes, quietly surveying the victim, waiting for the moment to strike.
raider: A black cloak with a mask hides the face, and only a pair of dim red eyes glow from under the hood, holding a dull knife.
He freezes in the shadows, slowly shifting sideways, as if preparing to leap with a knife ready for a backstab.
bwolf: His bones dimly glow, and cold blue flames dance between his ribs.
The wolf tensed, slowly circling the hero, ready to pounce.
crawler: He resembles a giant scorpion with scaly armor and a poisonous stinger on his tail hanging over the rubble.
Hearing your steps, he freezes, then sharply turns, trying to throw you with his heavy stinger.
beetle: A massive armored bile with a shell shining like broken iron and sharp limbs ready to tear apart anything alive.
Spotting you, the beast freezes instantly, its shell cracking as it shifts to an aggressive red before charging.
toad: A giant green frog-like monster with rough, bumpy skin and a monstrous mouth that overshadows its tiny eyes.
He freezes on the swamp, rolling on his thick limbs, then instantly opens his maw to swallow the unknown in the black cloak.
necro: A teen in a worn hoodie with glowing green eyes stands surrounded by skeletons quietly grinding their teeth.
He immediately recognizes you as the primordial enemy and waves his hand, making skeletons rush into an attack with a manic giggle.
scav: He stands in a dirty cloak made of bones, wearing an old gas mask, with a homemade bow marked with death signs on his back.
The Scavenger freezes, raises his weapon, and stares at you intently, as if weighing whether your meat is worth the risk.
wasp: A giant bee with a body like a fragile, transparent crystal shimmering with cold light.
She abruptly stops buzzing, tilts her head, and scans you with barely visible, fragile eyes.
knight: He stands like a living rusty frame, wrapped in thick gray Fog, with no face under the helmet.
Silently, he sharply turns his head toward the hero, as if sensing his presence, and takes a slow step forward.
drone: Guardian drone: a black metal cube with three spinning gears and a red scanning beam instead of eyes.
He abruptly stops, scans the hero with a red beam, and instantly switches to attack mode without waiting for anything.
eyes: His body is pierced by hundreds of living eyes gleaming in the dark, with slimy tentacles crawling out.
Locking eyes, the monster freezes for a moment, then suddenly lunges with all limbs toward you.
golem: A huge humanoid figure forged from metal scraps and rebar, with a bright orange core burning in its chest.
He freezes in place, tensely turning his head to focus the core's light on you, as if assessing a new target for destruction.
hive: She glows like a giant living hive with red eyes burning in the dark.
She rushes toward the hero, releasing a cloud of small mutant drones around her.
chem: Green LED poison oozes from his torn chemical armor, hissing like it's alive.
The beast freezes, eyes glinting cunningly, silently approaching as if waiting for you to walk into the poisonous puddle.
spider: He has five metallic legs with sharp spikes and a red light burning in the dark morgue.
Seeing you, he instantly shifts his gait, lunges on all fours, and draws sharp blades from his belly.
wraith: A pale, glowing face sticks out from under a torn gray cloak, resembling a dying moon.
The monster instantly freezes, staring into your eyes, before trying to squeeze through the wall.
fox: A silver creature with a tail of pure light, glowing like a star cluster, stands quietly on the ruins.
He instantly senses the threat, dashes into the Fog, and leaves only a shiny bone at the last moment.
mimic: Old worn suitcases lie on the ground, but its open flap resembles a wide maw with a tongue-belt and sharp teeth.
The creature instantly recoiled from the hero, sealed its valve, and fled into the Fog, leaving only a silver coin.
deer: A rare creature with a body that glows as if absorbing sunlight, and horns of pure magical light.
Instead of attacking, it instantly turns and dissolves into the fog, leaving only a light-silver trophy on the ground.
bard: A thin skeleton in a tattered cloak plays a violin, emitting notes as pale as the Fog.
He freezes upon appearing, then sharply turns and flees, scattering his magical chords.
scarab: His armor gleams like molten gold under the fog's dim light, and his wings whisper a enchanted flight.
He instantly dashes upward, hiding in the canopy of a ruined building as soon as he notices your gaze.
jelly: It glows with a soft blue light, resembling a giant transparent jellyfish levitating above the ground.
Seeing you, she instantly fades and hides in the thick Fog, not waiting for you to approach.
paper: A tiny paper dragon flutters its wings; its scales shine with folds made of expensive silver paper.
Seeing you, the creature instantly froze, then quickly flew into the Fog without trying to grab you.
clock: A strange mechanism with a brass body where gears replace fur, and eyes burning like a living cat's.
He instantly flees, hiding in the shadows, and only when the hero gets closer does a trophy rain from his body.
hound: A skeletal sand creature with cracked skin glowing purple, fog dripping from it.
He sees you and lunges forward with a hoarse howl, ignoring all obstacles.
giant: A giant figure made of dense gray fog and stone fragments, with two burning eyes instead of a face.
He instantly senses the hero and approaches heavily, gloomily, as if ready to crush all life under his foggy feet.
hybrid: A scared pile of bloody mold with teeth sticking out, and greenish slime flowing from torn limbs.
He silently creeps toward you, emitting a rotten wheeze, then suddenly lunges into an attack, tearing the air with sharp claws.
sniper: A Snap deserter stands in a torn cloak and gas mask, gripping a long rifle.
He instantly raises his weapon and sizes up the hero, as if deciding he will be the first victim of his new order.
worm: A giant pale gray worm bursts from the asphalt, scattering cobblestones, its mouth filled with sharp ringed teeth.
The monster instantly curls into an arc and lunges at the hero, dispersing the Fog like a merciless sharp blade.
puppet: The Puppeteer wears a porcelain mask with no face and unnaturally long fingers stretching through the thick Fog like foreign strings.
He freezes when he notices you, then sharply tilts his head, as if trying to determine who you would become as his new doll.
sentinel: He stands like a large black stone boulder, clad in patched armor, holding a shield with a pulsing red rune.
Seeing the hero, the monster freezes for a moment, then lunges forward, scattering debris and raising a shield for a strike.
angel: The Gray Angel is a weary figure with ashen feathers and an empty golden crown above its head, resembling a dead angel from fairy tales.
This monster instantly freezes and slowly spreads its wings when it notices the hero, as if waiting to tear him apart.

first: Listen, boy, I can't see you, but I hear you're new to this town.
Hi, young man, want to buy something useful? I've got what you need.
again: You again? Fine, let today be a quiet day.
Oh, it's you, boy. How's your survival going?
friend: Glad to see you alive, friend, come in, let's talk.
Hi, old friend; always happy to see you.
hostile: You're back again, scum. What do you want from me?
Get out of here, I don't want to see your white eyes again.
trade: Got a great knife instead of water, want to trade?
I'll trade a bag of salt for your old weapon, deal?
I have meds worth your old cloak.
threat: Stop, or you'll have to pay {toll} to pass.
If you don't pay {toll}, I won't let you leave.
Pay {toll}, or find out how a fight with my staff ends.
bye: Goodbye. May fate smile on you.
See you, kid. Stay safe in the Fog.
beaten: You beat me, but this time I'll be more careful.
Alright, you're stronger, but I won't forget how you beat me.
lostTo: Your backpack is mine now, and your luck—no, it's not yours.
Take only your body; the rest belongs to me.

first: Hi, kid, I haven't seen any new fish around, but your hair looks strangely clean.
You're a newbie? Don't keep your hands in your pockets, or I'll think you're carrying something stolen.
again: Back again? If you have nothing to buy, better leave.
Greetings, old man. Just don't tell me you're lost in the Fog again.
friend: Oh, it's you, pal! Come in, I just brewed hot watermelon tea, sit with us.
Glad to see you, friend! Your help with the engine was priceless, take this.
hostile: I haven't forgotten how you let me down back then, and this time I won't forgive.
You're back on my territory? Ready for a good hit on the head if you don't leave.
trade: I'll take your parts, and give you a couple of cans of meat. It's a fair trade.
Need a propeller? Fine, but I'll take only a bit of water for it.
I have a good tool, but it costs more than you can give now.
threat: Get out of here, or I'll take what you have for {toll}.
If you don't pay {toll} right now, I'll take you apart for parts.
Don't go further until you pay {toll}, or it'll get rough.
bye: Hey, don't get lost in the fog when you go.
See you around, I hope you don't get into a fight this time.
beaten: Fine, I admit you're stronger than me in a fight, but that doesn't mean I trust you.
Sounds like a win for you, but I haven't forgotten how you beat me.
lostTo: Ah, it's you! Now you see why I took your backpack, not yours mine.
My backpack is now where yours was, and I won't give it back, because I'm stronger.

first: Who are you, blond clown, and why wander here where your parents don't belong?
Wow, newcomer! Don't forget to thank me for not eating you alive yet.
again: You again? Hope you didn't come begging this time.
Hi, kid. You look like you lost your mind again in this Fog.
friend: Oh, it's you! Let's drink to the fact that we're still alive, my little friend.
Alright, buddy, I can relax and even laugh with you, as weird as that sounds.
hostile: I remember your face and everything you did to me, and this time I won't forgive!
You think you're winning? I've already seen your death, and it was as vile as you.
trade: Want strong armor? Then give me everything you have, plus a bit more.
I know where resources are hidden, but at the cost of one of your backpacks, if you have one.
Want to survive today? Share your food, and I'll give you a map worth your honor.
threat: Pay {toll}, or I'll take your skin as payment for your ignorance.
If you don't hand over {toll}, I'll turn you into a tasty snack for mutants, got it?
Take {toll} and get lost, or I'll show you how my bell hurts.
bye: Go away before I change my mind and decide to kill you.
Not yet, kid. Hope the Fog doesn't eat you too fast.
beaten: You thought you won? I'll be back, and next time I'll hold you by the throat.
Alright, you won for the first time, but I remember that hit and will do everything to get revenge.
lostTo: Your backpack is mine now, and your head is a trophy I'll show everyone in the city.
You fought like a cat, but got beaten like a dog. Take your body and get out, before I change my mind.

first: Hi, kid with the cloak, I'm Tessa, and I've got more good stuff in my backpack than this whole city.
Oh, who's this young one here? Come in if you want to buy something useful, not just stare at the ruins.
again: You again, boy? Ready to trade or just wander?
Hi, Tessa on the line; I have some interesting news for you.
friend: You're here, and it's all clear now, my little white-haired hero.
How's it going, friend? Come in, I always have something tasty for you.
hostile: You're back again, traitor. I remember how you abandoned me in my past life.
Don't approach me if you don't want me to banish you from this area forever.
trade: Want to buy food? Here's everything I have, at the price you know.
I have what you were looking for, but the price is a bit higher today than usual.
Look at this item; it will save you from hunger if you're willing to pay.
threat: Want to go further? Pay the toll {toll}, or I won't let you pass.
Listen closely, my little one, {toll} is the price for your life here.
If you don't pay {toll}, I'll take everything you have and beat you.
bye: Goodbye. Remember, I'm always here if you need help.
Go in peace, but remember Tessa always sees.
beaten: You beat me again, but I won't give up. We'll meet soon.
Alright, you're stronger, but this time I'll take what's mine when the time comes.
lostTo: Ha-ha, I took your backpack again, kid, and lost nothing.
You're so weak I didn't even bother fighting—just took it and left.

first: Oh, who's this newcomer? Don't look so familiar, kid.
Good morning to you too. Now, who are you?
again: Seeing you again, heh-heh, don't hide.
Hi, old friend, how are you doing?
friend: Well, you're quite the guy, buddy. Glad to see you!
Oh, it's my friend! How glad I am that you're alive.
hostile: Keep your hands off me, or I'll crush you!
I remember what you did to me—now you'll pay for it all!
trade: Want to trade food for my fists? I have an option.
I'll give you some water if you hand over your supplies.
I have a few valuable items, but they come with a price.
threat: Pay the toll to pass, or I'll hit you in the face—{toll}.
Don't go further until you pay {toll}!
Leave your backpack or take {toll} hits!
bye: Go in peace, don't forget me.
See you, if you don't kill yourself first.
beaten: Don't look at me like that, or I'll be back!
Alright, you won, but next time I won't miss.
lostTo: Look at yourself, now you don't have my backpack, haha!
I took your stuff, and you're still asking for forgiveness? Fool!

first: Newcomer? You don't look like someone who's lasted long here.
Oh, a child with white hair. Didn't think anyone else was still walking alive here.
again: You're here again. Hope you won't be dead weight this time.
Met again? Hope your pockets are fuller than last time.
friend: Hi, old man. Ready for another walk among the ruins?
Glad to see you alive. Sometimes it's too boring here without you.
hostile: You're back again? If you don't want to end up like the rest, get out.
I remember how you tried to trick me last time. Now I know you.
trade: Got some water and a knife, but I need your meat for stew.
I'll trade your old dagger for 1.5 liters of pure water.
I have bandages. Give me everything in your backpack, and I'll trade.
threat: This passage costs {toll}, or I'll cut your cloak.
Pay the toll—{toll}, or I'll take your backpack right here.
Move or pay {toll}, I hate delays.
bye: Don't vanish here, or I'd have to bury you.
Go away before I change my mind about being polite.
beaten: Alright, I lost. Just don't think this is the last vision.
Your fists are stronger than I thought. Next time will be different.
lostTo: Ouch, too bad. Your backpack is mine now, and you're empty.
I took your supplies because you played worse than expected. That's you, not me.

first: Time changes, but the Fog remains the same, child.
I haven't seen you on these lands, so watch your step.
again: You're here again, like a crow circling the ruins.
Your shadow is long, as always, my young friend.
friend: Glad to see you alive, old friend.
Your gaze is brighter now than on the first day, friend.
hostile: Betrayal smells worse than rot, and I remember your eyes.
Your path would end here, if not for my mercy.
trade: I have what you need, but the price demands honor.
We'll trade your knowledge for my herbs, if you dare.
A priceless resource for a moment of time, right?
threat: To go further, pay {toll} and don't touch my roots.
If you don't hand over {toll}, the Fog will come for you sooner.
Leave {toll} on the ground; my staff doesn't forgive bulging pockets.
bye: May the Fog not tangle your feet. Go with God.
The world is too cruel for people like us, but you survived.
beaten: You taught me that strength is not just magic.
My staff cracked from your blows, and I remember it.
lostTo: Your backpack is mine now, and you're just a shadow in my memory.
You thought you'd defeat the elder, but the Fog decided otherwise.

first: This isn't a place for newcomers, but your eyes aren't like others.
Shut up, I'm Liia. Don't touch me or get in my way.
again: You're back. Hope you brought something useful.
No time for talk. Get lost if you're not here to help.
friend: Hi, I'm glad you're alive and whole.
You know, I'm always glad for your company in this Fog.
hostile: I remember how you tried to trick me.
You again? Get lost before I decide what to do with you.
trade: I have water for your metal. Want to trade?
Give me food, and I'll give you the key to the stash.
If you hand this over, I'll give you a discount at the next checkpoint.
threat: Whoever doesn't pay {toll} becomes mutant food.
The toll here is {toll}, or I'll take everything you have.
Either pay {toll}, or I'll show you what real Fog looks like.
bye: Go in peace, hope the Fog doesn't eat you today.
See you. Hope we meet healthy.
beaten: You beat me, but that doesn't mean you're better.
Good fight, but remember: next time I won't forgive you.
lostTo: Your backpack is mine now, and you're just a shadow in the fog.
I took your supplies because you're too weak to hold them.

first: Hey, kid, did you crawl out of that fog?
Where are you running, boy? Can't you see who's in charge here?
again: Oh, you again. What's new on your path?
Hi, old man, didn't forget how to live here?
friend: I see you're breathing, kid. Stick with us.
Hey, brother. Come in if you need rest.
hostile: One more reminder: you're in my zone. You'll die quietly.
You remember how you put me to sleep? Now cry.
trade: I take your trash, give you food. Deal?
Got something to give for my goods, or just watching?
Clear and fast, or I take everything you have.
threat: Give me {toll}, or you won't walk this road again.
Take {toll}, or I'll make you my lunch.
{toll} — this is your price for life, pay or go to the Fog.
bye: Go already, don't stall, time's running.
Bye, kid. Don't die before we meet again.
beaten: You thought you won? I'll be back.
Seems I overloaded a bit, but you're still weak.
lostTo: I took your backpack. Now you're nobody's, kid.
You're funny when you run, while I take everything you have.

first: You just woke up in this hell, kid? Watch your step, not the Fog's.
I don't dream of the past. You seem to still not realize it's already dead. Watch your back.
again: You're back again. Hope this time you're not walking to death without reason.
I see your eyes again. Hope you learned at least a little not to make mistakes.
friend: Alright, old man, you survived. That's worth something. Drink tea before the fog thickens.
Glad to see you alive. Your wisdom grows, and I notice it.
hostile: I remember your betrayal, and now you'll pay for every mistake with blood.
Your dirty nature hasn't vanished, even if the world burned. Prepare for the end.
trade: I have what you need, but your soul costs more than meat.
We'll trade items if you're ready to give up everything you have, without regret.
I give nothing without benefit. What will you offer in exchange for your life?
threat: Come in if you can pay: {toll} or stay here to rest.
Pay {toll}, or I can't guarantee you'll leave here alive.
Toll for people like you: {toll}, or your backpack becomes mine.
bye: Go quietly, don't wake the dead.
Remember: the Fog always returns. See you soon.
beaten: You won this time, but the Fog hates winners. You won't forget that.
My pain will remember your strike. We'll meet again.
lostTo: Your backpack is mine now, and your status is my laugh. Don't stop me.
I took everything you had. Now you're poor and hopeless. Isn't that fun?

trade: Trading your medkits for hardtack, but only fairly.
I have a map of safe zones. Want to trade your meat for it?
Give me three bullets, and I won't stand in your way to the Rift.
threat: Here's {toll} for passing through my sector, or you'll get your teeth broken.
If you don't pay {toll}, I'll take all your gear and leave.
Listen, {toll} is the price for your life. Pay up, because I'm not joking.
bye: Hit it, don't die on my watch.
See you, stay safe, the Fog's especially thick today.

trade: Got some water and ammo, want to trade for old city maps?
Seems you have what I need. Let's trade without words.
I see you're packing. I'll give you a better price for what you couldn't take.
threat: Paying {toll} is the only way I won't tear you apart for parts.
Either pay {toll}, or leave your blood and gear here.
Don't dare ignore {toll}, or next time I won't say goodbye so gently.
bye: Don't delay before I change my mind about your life.
Remember, every step in this city costs dearly.

trade: I'll trade your ammo for my medkit if you don't want to die from infection.
I have a cool weapon I found in a Rift. Want to trade it for food?
Haggle, kid, because the Fog won't wait for your thoughts.
threat: Either pay {toll} to pass, or stay here for the mutants' lunch.
If you don't hand over {toll}, I'll just take your things by force.
Stop and pay {toll}, or I won't play mercy.
bye: Bye, and remember, next time the Fog might be crueler.
Go, before I change my mind.

trade: Want this fighting knife? I'll take half a ration.
I have water, but the price is your old coat.
I have a stash map, but it's only worth it if you can give me something valuable.
threat: Pay the toll {toll}, or my knife will be your last acquaintance.
If you don't pay {toll}, I won't let you pass through this Fog.
Hand over {toll} now, or I'll summon mutants on your head.
bye: Get out, before I change my mind.
Don't cross paths if you don't want to lose everything.

storm: The wind howls so hard that clouds seem alive, wanting to wash the city off the map.
The Fog thickens, and water pours on the streets like a river from the sky.
Through the storm, I hear only the rustle of a cloak and the desperate thud of barrels filled to the brim.
fog: The Fog squeezed the city in a tight white hand, leaving no room for light.
Morning air grew thick, as if the ruins themselves exhaled old pain.
Thick white gloom promises more dangers and less luck today.
caravan: Through the gray fog came the rumble of wheels, and at dawn a caravan is already humming at the base's edge.
Fresh air mixed with the smell of coal as the first carts approached the gates.
Strange to hear traders' haggling and horse hooves instead of ruin silence.
heat: Morning air is already thick like hot cloth; every breath feels like a trial.
Sunlight pierces the thick Fog, turning it into a sticky, burning shroud.
The world around seems melted, and the dry air trap quickly drains the last of your strength.
frost: Cold swallowed my bones before I could even open my eyes.
The Fog around the house grew denser and colder, as if Death herself wanted to hug me.
My breath left as a cloud, instantly freezing in the air.
looters: The Fog over the warehouse is thicker than usual, as if someone invisible walked here last night.
In the morning, the air smells of old metal and something rotting, as if shadows from the Fog haven't left this area.
It's quiet around, but the feeling that someone watches from behind won't let you rest since morning.
bounty: The Fog parted, as if the city itself decided to gift me a second chance.
The air felt strangely light, as if the ruins suddenly grew richer.
Morning made everything seem strangely generous, as if the old world was paying its debts.

spring: Rain doesn't wash dirt off cobblestones; it turns it into black sludge smelling of rot.
Gray Fog spreads over the ruins, hiding from sight what hasn't yet turned to bones.
summer: Heat pours over scorched ruins, turning every breath into a suffocating trial.
The Fog has thickened around, but it doesn't get easier; breathing only gets harder.
autumn: The autumn wind carries the smell of rotting earth from the Fog, reminding you that even the harvest must now be stolen from your own shadows.
Yellow leaves swirl over ruins, falling heavily like the city's last tears, too late to cry.
winter: Cold seeps through broken windows, stealing the last warmth from the stone ruins.
The Fog settles on the rooftops thicker than black snow, silent, as if afraid to break the quiet.

intro: I woke up in my room and instantly realized this wasn't a dream, but the first morning of my second life.
The memory of a friend's betrayal still burned in my heart, but now I have a chance to set things right.
Suddenly, a pale blue window with unknown text floated in the air, visible only to me.
The System gave me instructions, and I felt I now control my new world.

danger: [System] Resources at zero, cannot risk more
[System] Body exhausted, need rest and food

[System] Nearby areas are quickly depleted, search further
